column1: # The function follow (P/09.1 N3 «follow», N5 follow): follow(keys, held, answers) → follow {term, holder, url} | stay {reason, term?}, and refused {<cluster>: <a word of record>}.
# input — the input of the command follow as JSON text: keys — the trusted document of the set (the domain key set contract), held — its own row domain/holder ({doc}) or null,
# answers — the row holder from /api/held of each console (or from 409 deposed), null — did not answer. expect — a subset of the output or «@exit 2» (the input is out of form).
# The rows — the acceptance inputs of M11/10 inputs/follow-*.json, sc. 06 (removed by the move of lesson 9).
